title: Route the default locomotion lower-limb response through the actual runtime state

observed_failure.dead_path: bApplyTrainingAlignedLocomotionLowerLimbResponsePolicy defaults true, but its runtime application is gated by bDistalLocomotionCompositionModeActive. That mode remains false when the independent distal composition policy is disabled by default, so the intended locomotion thigh/calf damping profile never activates.

hypothesis: Activating the already-default-enabled thigh/calf locomotion damping profile whenever RuntimeState is LocomotionActiveShell will reduce moving root tilt without changing action targets, standing behavior, Pose Search, shell speed, or the scripted scenario.
single_behavior_change: Define the locomotion response mode as LocomotionActiveShell OR the legacy distal-composition mode, and pass that mode to ShouldApplyTrainingAlignedLocomotionLowerLimbResponsePolicy. No numerical damping scale changes.
tdd_contract: LocomotionActiveShell activates the response mode even when distal composition mode is false.
BalanceActive_Standing does not activate the response mode when distal composition mode is false.
The legacy distal-composition mode still activates the response profile in other states.
All standing and Stage2 focused suites remain green.
The scripted Normal run preserves path, turn, non-idle Pose Search, and stop/settle behavior.
next_if_supported: Recompute Normal versus ZeroActions. If the ratio remains above 0.9, use the phase decomposition to preregister the next single-variable controller correction.
